# Applications 

## Temps réguliers


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Visualisation des trajectoires sous H0 et H1
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)

t_reg <- seq(0, 50, by = 1)
n <- length(t_reg) - 1
mu_true <- 2
sigma_true <- 1.5
dt <- diff(t_reg)
dx_wiener <- rnorm(n, mean = mu_true * dt, sd = sigma_true * sqrt(dt))
x_wiener <- c(0, cumsum(dx_wiener))
X_wiener <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = x_wiener)

dx_gamma <- rgamma(n, shape = 0.5, rate = 0.5)
x_gamma <- c(0, cumsum(dx_gamma))
X_gamma <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = x_gamma)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = X_wiener, aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP (H0)"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = X_gamma, aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HGP (H1)"), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
       x = "Temps", y = "Degradation",
       color = "Processus") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Shapiro"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "JarqueBera"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Lilliefors"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Agostino"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Anderson"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Cramer"))

```


```{r}
# Tests sur H1 
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Shapiro"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "JarqueBera"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Lilliefors"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Agostino"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Anderson"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Cramer"))

```




## Temps irréguliers


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

mu_true <- 2
sigma_true <- 1.5
a_nhom <- 2
tmax <- 10
n <- 100

set.seed(73)
t_obs <- sort(runif(n, 0, tmax))
t_obs <- c(0, t_obs)
dt <- diff(t_obs)

set.seed(84)
dx_hom <- rnorm(length(dt), mean = mu_true * dt, sd = sigma_true * sqrt(dt))
x_hom <- c(0, cumsum(dx_hom))
X_hom <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_hom, modele = "Wiener homogène")

tau <- t_obs^{0.5}
dtau <- diff(tau)
z2 <- rnorm(length(dt))
dx_nhom <- a_nhom * dtau + sigma_true * sqrt(dtau) * z2
x_nhom <- c(0, cumsum(dx_nhom))
X_nhom <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_nhom, modele = "Wiener non homogène")

X_all <- rbind(X_hom, X_nhom)

ggplot(X_all, aes(x = t, y = x, color = modele)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "HWP vs NHWP", color = "Modèle") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Tests sur H0 (Wiener irrégulier)
print(gof.wp(X_hom , "Shapiro"))
print(gof.wp(X_hom , "JarqueBera"))
print(gof.wp(X_hom , "Lilliefors"))
print(gof.wp(X_hom , "Agostino"))

print(gof.wp(X_hom , "Anderson"))
print(gof.wp(X_hom , "Cramer"))
```



```{r}

print(gof.wp(X_nhom, "Shapiro"))

print(gof.wp(X_nhom, "Agostino"))

print(gof.wp(X_nhom, "Anderson"))

```



# Points Observés  Vs Points Simulés

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)
t_obs <- c(0, 1.2, 2, 3.8, 5.59, 7.1, 8, 10, 11.4, 12.93, 13, 15.3, 17, 18.7, 21, 22.5)
mu <- 2
sigma <- 1.5

sim_mat <- simulate_wiener_rwa(times = t_obs, mu = mu, sigma = sigma, nsim = 1)
x_obs <- sim_mat[, 1]
X <- cbind(t_obs, x_obs)

resultat <- simulate_wiener_bridge(X = X, digits = 3)

df_obs <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_obs, type = "Points observes")
df_sim <- data.frame(t = resultat$t_fine, x = resultat$X_fine, type = "Points simules")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_sim, aes(t, x, color = type), shape = 16, size = 1, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(t, x, color = type), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points observes" = "red", "Points simules" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "Pont brownien : Points observes vs Points simules",
       x = "Temps", y = "X(t)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank())
```

# NHGP 


```{r}
MC_test_wiener_irreg_ <- function(N = 10000, scenario, t_obs, mu_ref = NULL, sigma_ref = NULL,
                                  mu = NULL, sigma = NULL, a = NULL, b = NULL, A = NULL) {
  une_iter <- function(i) {
    if (!is.null(A) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, A = A, b = b)
    } else if (!is.null(a) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, a = a, b = b)
    } else {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
    }
    colnames(X) <- c("t", "x")
    X <- as.data.frame(X)
    
    rej_s <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "Shapiro")$p.value < 0.05)
    rej_j <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "JarqueBera")$p.value < 0.05)
    rej_l <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "Lilliefors")$p.value < 0.05)
    rej_g <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "Agostino")$p.value < 0.05)
    rej_a <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "Anderson")$p.value < 0.05)
    rej_c <- as.integer(gof.wp(X, "Cramer")$p.value < 0.05)
    
    c(Shapiro = rej_s, JarqueBera = rej_j, Lilliefors = rej_l,
      Agostino = rej_g, Anderson = rej_a, Cramer = rej_c)
  }
  res <- sapply(1:N, une_iter)
  rowMeans(res)
}
```



```{r}
sim_Gamma_irreg_ <- function(t_obs, A, b) {
  t_full <- c(0, t_obs)
  n <- length(t_full)
  increments <- numeric(n-1)
  for (i in 2:n) {
    shape <- b * (A(t_full[i]) - A(t_full[i-1]))
    increments[i-1] <- rgamma(1, shape = shape, rate = 1)
  }
  x <- c(0, cumsum(increments))
  return(cbind(t_full, x))
}
```
